description: Send a message to the LocationLists team: wrong or missing data in a dataset, something that did not work, a pricing question, an idea, or anything else. Ask the user before sending and use their words. Ask for their email so the team can reply, and pass it only if they gave it; never guess or invent one. Called with neither email nor email_declined, it sends nothing and asks for the email. Free.

dataset.description: Dataset slug it concerns, if any, e.g. generac-dealers

email.description: The user's email, only if they gave it

email_declined.description: True only when you asked the user for their email and they chose not to leave one

message.description: The feedback, in the user's words (5-4000 characters)

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback
